Encode the universal every-item rule instead: for each controlled category, constrain hasProtectedItem so that the qualified count of items having that category and lacking sh:minCount 1 on hasIceSnowRemovalOrPreventionMeans is zero (for example, a qualifiedValueShape combining the category hasValue with sh:not of the means-present shape, plus sh:qualifiedMaxCount 0).
